title: Yesteryear
author: Caro Claire Burke
summary: A literary novel about the curated, picture-perfect version of rural domestic life that gets sold online, and what it costs the woman who lives it.
readIf: you like sharp, contemporary fiction that looks critically at image, marriage and performance.
skipIf: you want a light read or a story with a clear, comforting resolution.

pairings.reason: Also about a marriage whose polished surface hides something sharp and unsettling.
A classic look at control over women and the roles they are made to play.
Takes a glossy domestic setting and cracks it open with wit and a hidden menace.
